title: Azure CLI sign-in state
whyItMatters: The Azure CLI folder caches sign-in tokens and lists every subscription and tenant the user could reach. A copied token cache can be replayed until it expires.
source: Microsoft Learn, Azure CLI configuration: the config directory is ~/.azure and holds azureProfile.json and the token caches: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cli/azure/azure-cli-configuration
notes: azureProfile.json lists subscriptions and tenants; msal_token_cache.* holds access and refresh tokens. The folder also appears on machines that only installed the CLI, so presence alone does not prove a sign-in.
